still._prompt_note: Three prompts so far. _prompt_flat (sweep work/dani/, seed 3 = the first still) asked for flat color and baked flat at 56 px. The first shaded pass (work/dani/shaded/) added cel shading, highlights, weighted accents and 'dramatic lighting, backlighting, official art': it shaded well but drifted to bright blue, warm orange rim and three-quarter or frontal views. This prompt (work/dani/shaded2/) keeps the shading tags, weights the pose and the flat ground, says dark navy, and puts the warm light, lens effects and frontal views in the negative.

still._chosen_note: shaded2 seed 6: the one clean profile T-pose of the sweep, mirrored so she faces right. It drew no wrench (no seed in a profile T-pose did), so the wrench is a prop still.

target._settings_note: Chosen 2026-09-06 on A/B strips (work/dani/ab_*.png). The still carries the tonal steps; lines/edge/accent each add a little on top: lines brings the seams back (0.2-0.22 coverage; 0.15 speckles, 0.3 misses a 4 px line in a 19 px block), lit edge puts a navy_ll rim on the back and hood, accent keeps the shin struts and visor highlight. k=3 lost colours and was dropped.

rig._comment: Joints in still pixels (832x1216, facing right, profile). The near arm is the extended one and is drawn against a hanging rest (rest 90), which is what the poses assume. The still's far leg (the left one) is cut into discard parts; far limbs are darkened copies of the near ones set a little behind. The wrench is a prop still (props.wrench) hung from hand_near.

parts.name: hood
parts._why: the still drew a hood; it is jacket, not head, so it rides the torso and sits behind the head

parts.name: weapon
parts._why: its own still: no profile T-pose seed drew a wrench, and cast.md wants the weapon swappable anyway
parts._rest_why: the prop still draws the wrench head up; rest 90 on top of the hanging arm turns it head down (cast.md)
parts._scale_why: the prop still is 900 px tall; 0.35 makes the wrench 16 art px, hip to knee when it hangs
